title: The FrontierOR Challenge: Agentic Algorithm Design for Operations Research
abstract: arXiv:2611.26171v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Operations research (OR) relies on algorithms that experts tailor to each problem: a new routing, scheduling or network design problem can take weeks of specialist work before it is solved well at scale. Large language model (LLM) agents now write, test and improve code, but whether they can design algorithms that scale to realistic instances is open: in the FrontierOR benchmark's one-shot evaluation, the strongest model matches Gurobi, with an objective within 1% of Gurobi's and no slower, on only 39% of the large instances. The FrontierOR Challenge asks teams to build agentic workflows that design, test, and improve algorithms for many optimization problems at once. Stage 1 releases 60 of the benchmark's 180 audited problems, spanning six application categories and five formulation types, in weekly rounds of 15; Stage 2 introduces new problems outside the benchmark, with unseen instances. translated_title: FrontierOR挑战赛：面向运筹学的智能体算法设计
translated_abstract: 运筹学（OR）依赖于专家针对每个问题量身定制的算法：一个新的路径规划、调度或网络设计问题，往往需要数周的专家工作才能在大规模下得到良好求解。大型语言模型（LLM）智能体现在已能编写、测试和改进代码，但它们能否设计出可扩展至真实实例规模的算法仍是悬而未决的问题：在FrontierOR基准的一次性评估中，最强的模型仅在39%的大型实例上能媲美Gurobi（目标值在Gurobi的1%以内且速度不慢）。FrontierOR挑战赛要求各团队构建智能体工作流，以同时为多个优化问题设计、测试和改进算法。第一阶段将分周发布基准180个经审核问题中的60个（每周15个），涵盖六个应用类别和五种建模类型；第二阶段则引入基准之外的新问题及未见过的实例。比赛设有两条赛道分别排名：主赛道（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: FrontierOR挑战赛邀请各团队构建基于LLM的智能体工作流，为多类优化问题自动设计、测试和改进可媲美商业求解器Gurobi的算法，以推动智能体算法设计能力的发展。
en_tdlr: The FrontierOR Challenge invites teams to build LLM-based agentic workflows that design, test, and improve algorithms for diverse optimization problems at scale, aiming to match commercial solver Gurobi and advance agentic algorithm design for operations research.
